name: Purna Anantha
title: Head of UX Writer Hub, Telkom Indonesia
summary: Multi-platform writer based in Jakarta. Ten years of advertising campaigns and scriptwriting, then UX writing and content strategy for digital products. Currently leads the UX Writer Hub at Telkom Indonesia. Before that, built the product content team at Bukalapak and the UX copywriting team at Pluang.

bullets: Lead Telkom Indonesia’s UX Writer Hub under the AI & Experience Chapter.
Manage a team of seven UX writers supporting multiple digital products across the organization.
Implement standardized content development processes, including tone-of-voice frameworks and guidelines.
Collaborate with design leadership to integrate content strategy throughout the product design lifecycle.
Lead an internal design audit task force to ensure output quality and design system compliance.
Individually contribute to Telkom Indonesia’s GenAI initiative, including product copywriting, conversation design, and persona development.
Built and led the UX copywriter team within the Product & UX organization.
Developed Pluang’s product tone of voice and ensured consistency across user journeys in alignment with brand guidelines.
Mentored two UX copywriters in crafting clear, helpful microcopy that improved usability and user experience.
Built the Product Content Strategist (UX writer) team from the ground up, growing it from zero to eight specialists.
Supervised the day-to-day work of Product Content Strategists and co-led Creative Content Strategist team to ensure key message uniformity across Bukalapak’s platforms.
Oversaw the quality of product copywriting across the ecosystem.
Led the development of Bukalapak’s product tone of voice, along with its principles and guidelines (2019).
Maintained and evolved the product copywriting guidelines as a core part of the design system (2019 - 2022).
Individually contributed to Mitra Bukalapak’s user experience and content strategy (2018 - 2019).
Handled above-the-line and digital campaigns for XL (Prioritas), HSBC, OPPO, Unilever (LUX and Molto), Sinar Mas (Freshplus), Mars Inc. (Snickers) and Changi Airport.
Handled above-the-line campaigns for Danone Baby Nutrition (Bebelac and Vitalac) and NET TV.
Handled above-the-line campaigns for Garuda Indonesia, Tempo Scan Pacific (Vidoran) and Unilever (Domestos).
Handled above-the-line campaigns for Nestlé (Dancow Batita and Milo), Philips (Lighting) and Prudential.
Handled Permatabank, Unilever, Nestlé, Konimex and CIMB Niaga as part of the below-the-line and unconventional media support team inside Ogilvy Group.
Wrote scripts and created lyrics for the Muppet segment in a 30-minute episode, supervised directly by Sesame Workshop.
Handled HSBC and Sunsilk.

skills: Tone of voice and writing guidelines
